text: After [a car accident on a stormy night|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] in Maine, schoolteacher Johnny Smith wakes from a five-year coma to find his girlfriend Sarah married and himself able to [see people's past and future through a touch|threat|powers of the mind]. A vision of [a nurse's daughter trapped in a fire|images|fire, smoke and burning] is only the start, and the gift leads him to a killer in Castle Rock while draining his strength. Then he shakes the hand of the charismatic Senate candidate Greg Stillson and sees [him as president ordering a nuclear strike|wants|power over others].
